verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data-export capability for Pipecat or Pipecat Cloud: no export of agents, sessions, logs, or account data in open formats. AudioBufferProcessor and turn-event transcript collection are developer building blocks for capturing data, not an export feature. Bot-file portability and the BSD-2 open-source license reduce code lock-in, but they are adjacent properties, not data export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
